lines.text: A Spanwright waystation. They rested here between repairs.
Aruun. When we fight, leave me a hole. When I see where they'll stand, pull them there.
Bramvex calls those Cigarra Holes. All right. When you see it, I'll make it land.
Combo unlocked — Probable Impact: Gravity Pull during Cigarra's Premonition deals double damage and stuns.
